reuse.why: Most month-wide actions share getMonthActionCategories and reuse existing budget, sheet, batching and undo helpers, but copyPreviousMonth retains its own eligibility implementation.

duplication.why: Category selection is consolidated for five actions, but hidden and template exclusions remain duplicated between the shared SQL selector and copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Budget policy and calculations remain in actions.ts, with typed method registration and undo wrapping in app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, relevant tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The shared selector improves ownership, but maintaining a separate eligibility path for copyPreviousMonth requires future policy changes to be coordinated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth bypasses getMonthActionCategories and independently applies month-wide eligibility checks.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden and saved-template exclusions as SQL predicates in getMonthActionCategories and as JavaScript early returns in copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter and conditional hidden-filter branch, while copyPreviousMonth maintains a separate eligibility implementation.
